p8_b6.ocr: By comparing baseline screening results from lung cancer patients (LCs, n = 13) to those observed during annual screenings (LCs, n = 21), we aim to elucidate the impact of longitudinal assessment on microbial diversity.

p8_b7.ocr: This analysis is pivotal in informing future research directions and clinical practices, as it highlights the importance of recurrent cross-sectional analysis and trajectory analysis in identifying significant changes in microbial communities. Ultimately, these findings contribute to a nuanced understanding of how screening processes influence patient outcomes and the overall trajectory of disease management.
